title: Detailed crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#80d0ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#2090e0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1060a0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcc44'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff9922'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc6600'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseTopGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe088'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffbb33'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- base platform bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#b85000'/>
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='44' height='8' rx='3' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='7' fill='url(#baseTopGrad)'/>

  <!-- base claw arms -->
  <path d='M32 80 Q28 72 36 68 L40 72 Q34 74 36 80 Z' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <path d='M68 80 Q72 72 64 68 L60 72 Q66 74 64 80 Z' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <path d='M42 78 Q40 72 46 68 L48 71 Q44 73 45 78 Z' fill='#ffbb33'/>
  <path d='M58 78 Q60 72 54 68 L52 71 Q56 73 55 78 Z' fill='#ffbb33'/>

  <!-- crystal ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='30' fill='url(#ballGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#40b0f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- swirl inside ball -->
  <path d='M32 42 Q38 32 50 36 Q62 40 64 52 Q66 62 54 62 Q42 62 40 52 Q38 44 46 42' fill='none' stroke='#88ccff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M40 55 Q46 62 56 58 Q66 54 62 44' fill='none' stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- sparkles inside -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='1' fill='#cceeff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- big highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='33' rx='12' ry='8' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-25 40 33)'/>

  <!-- small reflection -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
